name: Nine Buying Tests Composite Score
note: Wyckoff's buying/selling checklist as an ensemble score. Eight of the nine tests are computed on every bar - objective met, climax plus secondary test, activity on rallies vs declines, stride line broken, higher supports, higher tops, base forming, reward at least rr times risk - and the entry is the bar on which the total crosses up through thr. T7 (stronger than the market) is DROPPED: it needs a benchmark's bars and the harness supplies one symbol. That leaves a 0-8 scale, on which the paper's 7-of-9 becomes 6-of-8; the default is 5 because 6 fires only a handful of times per symbol on intraday bars, and the grid sweeps 4/5/6 so the cost of demanding more tests is measured rather than assumed. Exit is score decay to exit_thr, the T9 objective, or the structural stop beyond the 60-bar extreme measured at entry.
source: The nine classic buying tests and nine selling tests are Wyckoff's, codified and published by Hank Pruden in 'The Three Skills of Top Trading: Behavioral Systems Building, Pattern Recognition, and Mental State Management' (Wiley, 2007), and taught in the Wyckoff Analytics / Wyckoff Stock Market Institute course material. The mapping of each qualitative test to a specific computable predicate, and the 7-of-9 threshold, are my quantification (synthesis).

from collections import deque


def _roll(vals, w, want_max):
    """Rolling extreme and the index it sits on, O(n). None until the window
    is full, so an early bar never scores off a two-bar 'range'."""
    n = len(vals)
    out = [None] * n
    at = [None] * n
    dq = deque()
    for i in range(n):
        v = vals[i]
        while dq and ((vals[dq[-1]] <= v) if want_max else (vals[dq[-1]] >= v)):
            dq.pop()
        dq.append(i)
        while dq[0] <= i - w:
            dq.popleft()
        if i >= w - 1:
            out[i] = vals[dq[0]]
            at[i] = dq[0]
    return out, at


def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    hi = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    cl = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    vo = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]

    # --- ATR(14) and the average-volume baseline -------------------------
    per = max(2, int(ctx.p.t_atr_n))
    atr = [None] * n
    acc = 0.0
    run = None
    for i in range(n):
        tr = hi[i] - lo[i] if i == 0 else max(hi[i] - lo[i], abs(hi[i] - cl[i - 1]),
                                              abs(lo[i] - cl[i - 1]))
        if i < per:
            acc += tr
            if i == per - 1:
                run = acc / per
                atr[i] = run
        else:
            run = (run * (per - 1) + tr) / per
            atr[i] = run
    avn = max(2, int(ctx.p.av_n))
    av = [None] * n
    s = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        s += vo[i]
        if i >= avn:
            s -= vo[i - avn]
        if i >= avn - 1:
            av[i] = s / avn

    w40, w60, w120 = 40, 60, int(ctx.p.t1_win)
    hh40, _ = _roll(hi, w40, True)
    ll40, _ = _roll(lo, w40, False)
    hh60, _ = _roll(hi, w60, True)
    ll60, _ = _roll(lo, w60, False)
    hh120, _ = _roll(hi, w120, True)
    ll120, _ = _roll(lo, w120, False)
    _, lo60at = _roll(lo, w60, False)
    _, hi60at = _roll(hi, w60, True)

    # --- T3 volume-on-rallies prefix sums --------------------------------
    pu = [0.0] * (n + 1)
    pun = [0] * (n + 1)
    pd = [0.0] * (n + 1)
    pdn = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        up = i > 0 and cl[i] > cl[i - 1]
        dn = i > 0 and cl[i] < cl[i - 1]
        pu[i + 1] = pu[i] + (vo[i] if up else 0.0)
        pun[i + 1] = pun[i] + (1 if up else 0)
        pd[i + 1] = pd[i] + (vo[i] if dn else 0.0)
        pdn[i + 1] = pdn[i] + (1 if dn else 0)

    # --- confirmed k-bar fractal swings, and the last two of each -------
    k = max(1, int(ctx.p.swing_k))
    shi = []
    slo = []
    sh2 = [None] * n            # (j1, p1, j2, p2) for swing highs
    sl2 = [None] * n
    for i in range(n):
        j = i - k
        if j - k >= 0:
            wnd_h = hi[j - k:j + k + 1]
            if hi[j] >= max(wnd_h):
                shi.append((j, hi[j]))
            wnd_l = lo[j - k:j + k + 1]
            if lo[j] <= min(wnd_l):
                slo.append((j, lo[j]))
        if len(shi) >= 2:
            a, b = shi[-2], shi[-1]
            sh2[i] = (a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1])
        if len(slo) >= 2:
            a, b = slo[-2], slo[-1]
            sl2[i] = (a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1])

    clx = float(ctx.p.clx_mult)
    sec_lo = float(ctx.p.sec_vol)
    sec_band = float(ctx.p.sec_atr)
    t3w = max(5, int(ctx.p.t3_win))
    t1k = float(ctx.p.t1_atr)
    basek = float(ctx.p.base_atr)
    rr = float(ctx.p.rr)
    gap0, gap1 = 3, 40

    bull = [0] * n
    bear = [0] * n

    for i in range(n):
        a = atr[i]
        if a is None or a <= 0 or av[i] is None or hh120[i] is None:
            continue
        c = cl[i]
        sb = 0
        ss = 0

        # T1 objective met
        if c <= hh120[i] - t1k * a:
            sb += 1
        if c >= ll120[i] + t1k * a:
            ss += 1

        # T2 climax and secondary test
        j0 = max(0, i - w60 + 1)
        cj = lo60at[i]
        if cj is not None and av[cj] is not None and vo[cj] >= clx * av[cj]:
            base = lo[cj]
            for t in range(cj + gap0, min(cj + gap1, i) + 1):
                if av[t] is None or atr[t] is None:
                    continue
                if base <= lo[t] <= base + sec_band * atr[t] and vo[t] <= sec_lo * av[t]:
                    sb += 1
                    break
        cj = hi60at[i]
        if cj is not None and av[cj] is not None and vo[cj] >= clx * av[cj]:
            base = hi[cj]
            for t in range(cj + gap0, min(cj + gap1, i) + 1):
                if av[t] is None or atr[t] is None:
                    continue
                if base - sec_band * atr[t] <= hi[t] <= base and vo[t] <= sec_lo * av[t]:
                    ss += 1
                    break

        # T3 activity bullish on rallies
        j0 = i - t3w + 1
        if j0 >= 0:
            nu = pun[i + 1] - pun[j0]
            nd = pdn[i + 1] - pdn[j0]
            if nu and nd:
                uv = (pu[i + 1] - pu[j0]) / nu
                dv = (pd[i + 1] - pd[j0]) / nd
                if uv > dv:
                    sb += 1
                if dv > uv:
                    ss += 1

        # T4 stride broken -- the line through the last two like swings
        q = sh2[i]
        if q is not None and q[2] > q[0]:
            line = q[1] + (q[3] - q[1]) * (i - q[0]) / (q[2] - q[0])
            if c > line:
                sb += 1
        q = sl2[i]
        if q is not None and q[2] > q[0]:
            line = q[1] + (q[3] - q[1]) * (i - q[0]) / (q[2] - q[0])
            if c < line:
                ss += 1

        # T5 higher supports / lower supports
        q = sl2[i]
        if q is not None:
            if q[3] > q[1]:
                sb += 1
            if q[3] < q[1]:
                ss += 1

        # T6 higher tops / lower tops
        q = sh2[i]
        if q is not None:
            if q[3] > q[1]:
                sb += 1
            if q[3] < q[1]:
                ss += 1

        # T8 base forming (symmetric)
        if hh40[i] is not None and (hh40[i] - ll40[i]) <= basek * a:
            sb += 1
            ss += 1

        # T9 reward at least rr times risk
        if hh60[i] is not None:
            up = hh60[i] - c
            dn = c - ll60[i]
            if up >= rr * dn:
                sb += 1
            if dn >= rr * up:
                ss += 1

        bull[i] = sb
        bear[i] = ss

    ctx.bull = ctx.series([float(x) for x in bull], "buy_score")
    ctx.bear = ctx.series([float(x) for x in bear], "sell_score")
    ctx.hh60 = ctx.series(hh60, "hh60")
    ctx.ll60 = ctx.series(ll60, "ll60")
    ctx.atrw = ctx.series(atr, "atr_w")
    ctx._w_ei = -1
    ctx._w_hh = None
    ctx._w_ll = None


def signal(ctx, i):
    thr = float(ctx.p.thr)
    b, pb = ctx.bull[i], ctx.bull[i - 1]
    s, ps = ctx.bear[i], ctx.bear[i - 1]
    if b >= thr > pb and not (s >= thr > ps):
        return 1
    if s >= thr > ps and not (b >= thr > pb):
        return -1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Score decay, the T9 objective, or the structural stop under the
    60-bar low measured at entry."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    p = ctx.positions[0]
    if ctx._w_ei != p["entry_i"]:
        ctx._w_ei = p["entry_i"]
        ctx._w_hh = ctx.hh60[p["entry_i"]]
        ctx._w_ll = ctx.ll60[p["entry_i"]]
    a = ctx.atrw[i]
    if a is None:
        return False
    px = ctx.c[i]
    xt = float(ctx.p.exit_thr)
    if p["side"] == "long":
        if ctx.bull[i] <= xt:
            return True
        if ctx._w_ll is not None and px <= ctx._w_ll - float(ctx.p.stop_atr) * a:
            return True
        return ctx._w_hh is not None and px >= ctx._w_hh
    if ctx.bear[i] <= xt:
        return True
    if ctx._w_hh is not None and px >= ctx._w_hh + float(ctx.p.stop_atr) * a:
        return True
    return ctx._w_ll is not None and px <= ctx._w_ll
